response.sql: WITH event_budget_amounts AS (SELECT e.event_name, b.amount FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL), event_name_averages AS (SELECT event_name, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM event_budget_amounts GROUP BY event_name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg FROM event_name_averages) SELECT ena.event_name, ena.avg_amount, ena.avg_amount - oa.overall_avg as difference, ena.avg_amount / oa.overall_avg as ratio FROM event_name_averages ena CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ena.avg_amount > oa.overall_avg ORDER BY ena.event_name
